note: ADR 005 sealed notification payload. ChaCha20-Poly1305 (RFC 8439): 12-byte nonce, 16-byte tag, wire form nonce ‖ ciphertext ‖ tag, base64url. The key is the one notification-key-v1.json derives, so the two fixtures chain: a pairing that agrees that key seals exactly this. The nonce is RFC 8439 section 2.8.2's, so a mismatch tells apart a broken cipher from broken framing. Plaintext keys are sorted because the host serializes a map; the device parses JSON and does not depend on the order. The host name carries a non-ASCII apostrophe on purpose — it is what a Mac is really called, and it pins UTF-8 handling across all three languages.
